title: Embodied First Exam
summary: Coding agents have passed many exams in the digital world. What is their first exam before entering the physical world? What the exam is, how nine coding agents do on its core set in three settings, and four findings on where they fail.

title: Fable 5.2 on EFE: Where Agentic Robots Succeed and Fail
summary: What robotic tasks can coding agents solve, under what physical-world constraints, and where do they fail? Which tasks each of ten agents fails and why, what information matters in Privileged versus Standard, where in a task agents fail, how they act, and how the harness, spending and the task instruction change the result.
